capabilities: Edit mind maps by dragging topics into a hierarchy
Open a topic's note directly from the map
Maintain a two-way index between topics and notes
Show note properties on map nodes
extras: Desktop only; mobile is not supported. Some features need a paid VIP license, and the full user manual is hosted on an external FlowUs site.
problem: Mind maps in Obsidian are usually standalone drawings, so the hierarchy behind a set of notes and how each idea was derived is not recorded anywhere.
summary: Mind map editor that links each map topic to its own note and keeps a two-way index between the map and the notes.
